Hi Julie + team,

Thanks again for the time earlier — excited to get the pre-sales demo scheduled and make sure procurement and security are aligned up front. We've found the best path for multi-region organizations is a short rotating cadence so all stakeholders (AE, SE, Customer Eng, Procurement, Security) see the same content at workable local hours.

Quick proposal (please reply with constraints):
- Week 1 (US-focused window): two sessions to cover technical demo + procurement overview
  - Suggested slots (US friendly): 2026-10-05 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (also 18:00 UTC) and 2026-10-06 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET
- Week 2 (EU overlap): move start times ~5 hours earlier so EU engineering can attend 11:00–14:00 CET
- Week 3 (APAC rotation): one evening slot that covers APAC morning (e.g., 2026-10-19 22:00 UTC => 07:00 AEST on 2026-10-20)

Goals for the thread:
- Confirm which roles need to be present for each session (procurement, security, SRE/CE).
- Lock a two-week rotating plan so we can run three sessions (one per global block) and then repeat if needed.
- Capture any procurement redlines upfront — I've attached a draft SOW and a sample rotation sheet to illustrate the 2-week cadence.

Attachments: Nebula_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (redlines welcome), demo_rotations_2weeks.xlsx (proposed slots matrix)

If easier, pick a slot on my calendar: https://cal.example.com/camila/nebulademo — otherwise reply with your availability windows for procurement/security.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes

camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Camila — thanks for the clear plan. A few constraints from our side:

- Procurement availability: generally Mon–Fri 13:00–15:00 UTC (they're in EMEA but block mornings for vendor reviews)
- Security: our SecOps team can do mornings (08:00–11:00 UTC) but only on Wednesdays/Thursdays; they need the audit-logs and data residency sections up front
- Our CEs (customer engineers) want a hands-on runbook example and a short checklist for entitlements (1 pager)

We like the rotating idea. Can we do this:
- Week 1 (US): 2026-10-05 17:00 UTC (12:00 ET) — this hits US folks and late EMEA; procurement can dial in at end, security may need a separate 30-min follow-up
- Week 2 (EU): 2026-10-12 10:30 UTC — procurement happy, security can attend for the first 40 minutes
- Week 3 (APAC): 2026-10-19 23:00 UTC — this is late but will allow APAC engineers to join at 08:00 SGT next day

Also, can you add a short agenda that calls out the security artifacts we'll show (audit logs export, retention settings, KMS/HSM notes)? Procurement asked for a DocuSign-ready SOW so they can start internal routing.

Julie Parker
Senior Integration Lead | Nebula Health
